item.title: What is the ‘Mother of all Deals’ and why the trade pact between India and Europe is seen as historic
item.description: European leader Ursula von der Leyen has called this agreement the "Mother of All Deals," meaning it's the largest and most important trade agreement ever. The key reason is that when India and 27 European countries come together, they will create the largest and most powerful trading market in the world.
